primary_metric: server process CPU milliseconds per semantically successful request
variation_rule: median paired CPU reduction must exceed both 8 percent and the observed baseline CPU/request relative range; otherwise inconclusive, collect more evidence
scope: Synthetic loopback read-only feed; provisional experimental budgets, no product SLO or capacity guarantee
screen: 3 alternating pairs, 2 seconds each, 0.5 second warmup, 2 workers, aggregate pacing ceiling 40 requests/s, 12000 rows, limit 1000, seed 17
mode2_confirmation: 300 second target hold per version, same configuration; 0/16/12000/100000 rows and tied-score skew screening
mode3_if_justified: Brief before implementation; 5 pairs per light/target/near-saturation regime and relevant sizes/skew; 300 second hold per version; at least 900 second finalist soak; integration, faults, resource and recovery checks
rollback: Choose preceding retained implementation and regenerate its disposable database; originals remain separate modules
